A new Fighter starts with: **Longsword, Shield, Potion of Healing, and Torches** (×2).

Defined in `worker/src/services/character.ts` (`createCharacter`, lines ~59 and ~65), which assigns starting gear by class — item IDs 2, 15, 17, 23. Item 23 is labeled "Torches" in the item table, though the code comment mislabels it "Rations" (tracked as bug B-09). The class/item mapping table lives in `docs/flows/character-creation.md`, and item definitions come from `worker/src/db/seed.md`/seed data.
